observation.label: DWS reduces all-in fee for the Xtrackers FTSE All World UCITS ETF and offers the most cost-efficient UCITS ETF for broad global equity indices
observation.scope: Publication officielle · Xtrackers · salle de presse
observation.value: DWS reduces all-in fee for the Xtrackers FTSE All World UCITS ETF and offers the most cost-efficient UCITS ETF for broad global equity indices

products.name: Xtrackers FTSE All-World UCITS ETF
products.evidence: As of 1 June 2026, DWS is reducing the annual all-in fee for the Xtrackers FTSE All-World UCITS ETF to 0.07 percent. This makes the ETF, in terms of the annual all-in fee, the most cost-efficient way to access large and mid-cap equities from developed and emerging markets in a single index. As a result, the ETF becomes even more attractive as a core building block for a broadly diversified global equity allocation.
